seo.h1: Does Red Lobster Still Have Endless Shrimp?

question: Does Red Lobster Still Have Endless Shrimp?
quick_answer: Endless Shrimp is back at Red Lobster, but only as a limited-time deal. It returned in April 2026 for the first time since the chain's 2024 bankruptcy, and came back again on August 17, 2026. It costs $24.99 at most locations and up to $29.99 in some markets, it is dine-in only, and you can mix and match five shrimp dishes. Red Lobster has not announced when the current run ends, so check with your local restaurant.
key_facts: Back for a limited time in 2026: from April 20, and again from August 17
$24.99 at most locations; up to $29.99 in some markets
Mix and match five shrimp dishes
The old $20 version helped push Red Lobster into bankruptcy in 2024

body.heading: Is Endless Shrimp available now?
body.text: Red Lobster brought Endless Shrimp back on April 20, 2026 for a limited time, and the run wrapped up in June. It returned for a second time on August 17, 2026, again as a limited-time deal. The company has not published an end date for the second run, so call your local Red Lobster or check its app before you go.

body.heading: How much Endless Shrimp costs
body.text: In 2026, Endless Shrimp costs $24.99 at most locations, and $29.99 in some higher-cost markets. That is up from $20 in 2023 and $15.99 in earlier years. The deal is for dine-in guests at participating restaurants only, so delivery and takeout orders don't qualify.

body.heading: The five shrimp dishes
body.text: You can mix and match five shrimp dishes and keep ordering more servings. The August 2026 lineup is Garlic Bread-Crusted Shrimp, Shrimp Linguini Alfredo, Garlic Shrimp Scampi, Parrot Isle Coconut Shrimp with piña colada sauce, and Walt's Favorite Shrimp, which is hand-breaded and fried. The April run had Marry Me Shrimp, in a tomato cream sauce, in place of the Garlic Bread-Crusted Shrimp. Like every Red Lobster meal, it comes with Cheddar Bay Biscuits.

body.heading: Why Endless Shrimp nearly sank Red Lobster
body.text: In 2023, Red Lobster's then-owner Thai Union made Ultimate Endless Shrimp a permanent menu item at $20. Diners loved it, but the chain lost about $11 million in a single quarter on the deal. The promotion was one of several problems behind Red Lobster's Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing in May 2024. After the restructuring, new CEO Damola Adamolekun dropped it, then brought it back in 2026 at a higher price and only for limited runs.
